name: io.github.Servosity/gradient-mcp
title: Gradient MSP MCP
description: CLI and MCP server for Gradient MSP Synthesize: usage push, billing drift, alert tracing.

environmentVariables.name: GRADIENT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the Gradient MSP API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

environmentVariables.name: GRADIENT_PARTNER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Synthesize partner API key, issued with the vendor key. Fill in this and the vendor key, or GRADIENT_TOKEN alone.

environmentVariables.name: GRADIENT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: The GRADIENT-TOKEN header value, base64("<vendorApiKey>:<partnerApiKey>"). Leave empty when you fill in the vendor and partner API keys; when set, it is used instead of them.

environmentVariables.name: GRADIENT_VENDOR_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Synthesize vendor API key (Integrations -> Custom -> Generate API Tokens). Fill in this and the partner key, or GRADIENT_TOKEN alone.

environmentVariables.name: GRADIENT_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

environmentVariables.name: GRADIENT_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and nothing is written to the local store. Leave blank to keep the local store.

environmentVariables.name: GRADIENT_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Gradient MSP requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.

environmentVariables.name: GRADIENT_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.
